description: A Wanchain PoS validator or Storeman node. Views by node type: PoS profile, rewards, flows; Storeman profile, flows, members. Default profile. flows pages with limit (1 to 25) and cursor (next_cursor) and includes stake returns (label Stake returned, no transaction). Every answer carries found, type and name; an exited PoS validator is found with status exit and its live state (stake 0), its history in flows; an address in none of these is found false.
